# MIKA Coral Gables — full machine-readable profile

> MIKA is Chef Michael White's Coastal Italian restaurant at The Plaza Coral Gables in Miami, Florida. Opened December 12, 2024. Handmade pasta, crudo and caviar, whole fish, dry-aged steaks, a 1,700-bottle cellar, and a Mediterranean dining room by Bishop Design.

Last updated: November 2026
Canonical site: https://www.mikacoralgables.com/

## Chef Michael White

- Full name: Michael John White
- Born: Beloit, Wisconsin, United States
- Education: Kendall College (Kendall Culinary Institute), Chicago, 1989
- Training: Ristorante San Domenico, Imola, Italy, seven years under Valentino Marcattilii; stages in Paris and the South of France
- Cuisine: Coastal Italian, Mediterranean, seafood, handmade pasta
- Role: Chef & Owner, MIKA Coral Gables
- Chef page: https://www.mikacoralgables.com/chef/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/chefbianco/
- Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_White_(chef)
- James Beard Foundation: https://archive.jamesbeard.org/index.php/chef/michael-white

### Career timeline

- 1989: Enrolls at Kendall College in Chicago.
- 1990s: Seven years at Ristorante San Domenico in Imola, Italy, with stages in Paris and the South of France.
- 2001: Chef de cuisine at Spiaggia, Chicago.
- 2002: Executive chef of Fiamma Osteria, New York; Michelin star in 2006.
- 2006: Publishes _Fiamma: The Essence of Contemporary Italian Cooking_.
- 2007: Partners with Ahmass Fakahany; the Altamarea Group opens Due Terre and Due Mari in New Jersey, followed by Convivio and Alto.
- 2009: Opens Marea on Central Park South in New York.
- 2010: Opens Ai Fiori at The Langham; Marea wins the James Beard Award for Best New Restaurant.
- 2013: Publishes _Classico e Moderno_ with Andrew Friedman; Costata and Ristorante Morini join the group.
- 2015: Opens Vaucluse on the Upper East Side.
- 2021: Leaves the Altamarea Group.
- 2022: Reopens The Lambs Club in New York as executive chef.
- 2023: Opens Paranza at Atlantis Paradise Island, Bahamas.
- 2024: Opens MIKA in Coral Gables on December 12; opens Santi in New York with BBianco.
- 2025: Opens Levant at La Concha Resort in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
- 2026: Opens Lions Den at The Stoneleigh in Dallas.

### Awards and recognition

- Six Michelin stars earned across his New York restaurants, including two at Marea and one at Ai Fiori.
- Five Michelin stars held simultaneously at his New York peak.
- James Beard Award for Best New Restaurant, 2010 — Marea.
- James Beard nominee for Best Chef: New York, 2010–2014.
- Marea: three stars from The New York Times and membership in Relais & Châteaux.
- Ai Fiori: one Michelin star and three stars from The New York Times.

### Cookbooks

- _Fiamma: The Essence of Contemporary Italian Cooking_ (2006)
- _Classico e Moderno: Essential Italian Cooking_ (2013, with Andrew Friedman)

### Philosophy

- "The hallmark of Italian food is its simplicity. Keep it simple and let the ingredients shine."
- "Truffles and blue jeans. Come as you are." — his shorthand for MIKA: fine ingredients without formality.
- Pasta is made by hand in house every day; the kitchen is a place to teach and mentor.

### Michael White at MIKA

White opened MIKA on December 12, 2024 at The Plaza Coral Gables with partner Alex Pirez of Mocca Group and operator Matt Safchik. It is his first stand-alone restaurant in Florida. The name MIKA is an Italian nickname for Michael and also the name of Pirez's daughter. White's mother is from Fort Pierce, Florida, and he has deep ties to South Florida.

MIKA's menu is Coastal Italian and Mediterranean, with crudo, handmade pasta, whole fish, veal and dry-aged steaks. The kitchen uses paprika oil, chorizo and feta alongside Key West shrimp and stone crab. The cellar holds about 1,700 bottles, with Italian, French, California and Greek wines. The Marea classic — fusilli with red wine braised octopus and bone marrow ragu — is on the dinner menu.

### Signature dishes at MIKA

- Spaghetti ($73): blue crab, Siberian sturgeon caviar, lemon butter.
- Fusilli ($58): red wine braised octopus, bone marrow ragu — the Marea classic.
- Lobster Risotto ($79): 1.5 lb Maine lobster, aged carnaroli, coral butter, lemon, basil.
- Veal Parmigiana ($96): bone-in chop, stracciatella, pomodoro, Parmigiano-Reggiano.
- Grilled Octopus ($32): garlic aioli, piquillo, chorizo vinaigrette.
- Crudo Misto ($76): hamachi, tuna, salmon, lemon caper vinaigrette, orange, caviar.

## Rooms and capacity

- 100-seat main dining room
- 36-seat private dining room, about 600 sq ft, with dedicated outdoor area
- Bar and lounge with marble bar
- 8,195 sq ft total at The Plaza Coral Gables
- Temperature-controlled cellar of about 1,700 bottles
- Design by Bishop Design; interiors feature plaster arches, olive trees, rattan pendants, caned chairs and amber velvet

## Policies

- Dress code: smart casual; no shorts, hats, tank tops, flip flops, or team/athletic attire
- Corkage: up to two 750ml bottles per table, $75 per bottle
- Service charge: 18% for parties of 10 or fewer, 23% for 11 or more
- Reservations open 90 days ahead on Resy; OpenTable shows instant availability
- Parties of 9+ are handled by the private dining team

## The Dolce Vita Passport

A personal, browser-saved keepsake of six MIKA rituals: the aperitivo at the marble bar, handmade pasta (including the Marea fusilli), Sunday supper, the 1,700-bottle cellar, the golden hour in the dining room and the 36-seat private table. No account, email, points or discounts. The passport is saved in the visitor's browser only.

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I reserve a table at MIKA?

Book instantly on OpenTable, reserve on Resy up to 90 days ahead, or call +1 305 404 2200.

### What is the dress code?

Smart casual. Shorts, hats, tank tops, flip flops, and team or athletic attire are not permitted.

### Can I bring my own wine?

Up to two 750ml bottles of wine per table, with a $75 corkage fee per bottle.

### Is there a service charge?

An 18% service charge applies to parties of 10 or fewer, and 23% for parties of 11 or more.

### Where do I park?

Valet parking is available at The Plaza Coral Gables, 3007 Ponce de Leon Blvd.

### Can I host a private event?

Yes. The private dining room seats 36 in about 600 sq ft with a dedicated outdoor area. The 100-seat main dining room is available for buyouts.

### What menus are available?

Dinner, Lunch, Sunday Supper with brunch, Aperitivo Hour and the seasonal Miami Spice menu.

### Who is the chef?

Chef Michael White, a Michelin-starred chef with six Michelin stars across his career, a James Beard Award winner, and founder of Marea in New York.

### When did MIKA open?

December 12, 2024, at The Plaza Coral Gables.

### What is Miami Spice at MIKA?

A three-course prix fixe menu for $65, Sunday through Thursday, usually August through October.

### Who is Michael White?

Michael White is an American chef from Beloit, Wisconsin, known for Coastal Italian cooking and for Fiamma Osteria, Marea and Ai Fiori in New York. He earned six Michelin stars across his New York restaurants, won the 2010 James Beard Award for Best New Restaurant with Marea, and opened MIKA in Coral Gables on December 12, 2024.

### Where is Michael White cooking now?

He is Chef & Owner of MIKA in Coral Gables and is often in the kitchen. He also cooks at Santi in New York, Paranza at Atlantis Paradise Island and Levant in San Juan.

### What should I order at MIKA?

Start with the crudo, lobster burrata or grilled octopus. The spaghetti with blue crab and Siberian sturgeon caviar and the fusilli with octopus and bone marrow are the signatures, followed by whole branzino, lobster risotto or bone-in veal parmigiana.
